priorityList: Use Quell to interrupt enemy spellcasting whenever necessary.
Cast Dragonrage as your primary burst cooldown, ensuring targets will survive at least 15 seconds.
Use Deep Breath if Strafing Run is about to expire or to benefit from Imminent Destruction in AoE.
Use Tip the Scales on Fire Breath whenever available for the instant Scalecommander setup.
Cast Fire Breath at Rank 1 to apply its damage-over-time effect and trigger Bombardments.
Cast Eternity Surge at Rank 1 to maximize Scalecommander efficiency.
Prioritize Disintegrate when Mass Disintegrate stacks are active to cleave your primary spender.
Spend Essence on Pyre in AoE (3+ targets) if Mass Disintegrate is not available or if Charged Blast stacks reach 12+.
Use Azure Sweep as your primary filler in AoE to generate Essence and stacks.
Cast Living Flame when Leaping Flames is active to hit multiple targets, or when Burnout procs.
Prioritize Azure Sweep if the Season 1 2-piece set bonus is active and Eternity Surge has less than 6 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use Verdant Embrace to trigger Scarlet Adaptation for a damage boost to your next Living Flame.
Activate offensive trinkets and potions during Dragonrage to maximize damage output.
Use Hover to maintain mobility and allow casting of empowered spells while moving.
Use Azure Strike as a low-priority filler if you are moving and Hover is unavailable.
